messages:
Maya (partnerships): Quick heads-up — VoltEdge joint perf run tomorrow 10:00am PT. Goal: validate efficiency envelope (perf per watt) across their 4U board and confirm kernel tuning impact on latency and steady-state throughput. Agenda: quick sanity sweep, tuned patch verification, deliverables + publish checklist.

Ben (VoltEdge): Thanks Maya — we'll provide PMBus and fan telemetry, rack map, and PDU access. What's the exact harness we should run?

Sasha (bench): Plan is: baseline sweep then tuned sweep. Example runner command: ```./run_bench --model fp16-70b --seq 1024 --batch 4 --sweep "freq:[1.1,1.3,1.5]" --power-sample 200ms``` Use that as the canonical invocation for the 70b case.

Priya (eng-runtime): Important note: disable KV caching for the first baseline pass (`--kvcache disabled`) so we get cold-start numbers. For tuned runs use `--kvcache enabled` and capture warmup traces. We'll also enable `--trace-kernel` for the kernel-diff run.

Arun (eng-ml): Please add quantization profile points (int8, 4bit) in the sweep matrix — we want tokens/sec, p50/p95 latency, and energy-per-token. Also capture sample outputs to ensure no quality regressions.

Ben (VoltEdge): We'll expose CSV telemetry: `timestamp_iso,power_w,board_temp_c,gpu_freq_mhz`. Is that schema acceptable? We can add RPM and inlet temp if needed.

Nora (docs): Schema is fine — please include a sample CSV row. We'll produce a short partner-run docs page with ingest instructions and the manifest spec. Suggested manifest keys: model, batch, seq, kernel_patch, cpu_governor, quant_profile, run_id.

Maya (partnerships): Scope lock suggestion: 3 models (7b, 70b, and a 1k-seq 7b scenario), two kernel states (stock, patch-A), and three frequency points. Deliverables: baseline CSVs, delta table, annotated kernel diffs, and a joint blog draft.

Sasha (bench): I'll create the delta table template. Columns: model | seq | batch | freq_mhz | kernel | tokens_per_sec | p50_ms | p95_ms | power_w_avg | joules_per_token | notes. Will push template to repo under `partners/voltedge/templates`.

Ben (VoltEdge): One compliance ask — publishing microbench numbers may require an internal approval on our side. We'll need ~5 business days to clear legal/marketing. Heads-up.

Priya (eng-runtime): Also a runtime note — when running tuned kernels use `--kernel-args 'sched=ondemand'` and capture `dmesg` output. Upload logs to `s3://redwood-partners/voltedge/3987654322/` (create folder before start).

BenchBot: Result ingest runner started for `voltedge-sweep-3987654322`. Estimated wall time ~3h :hourglass_flowing_sand: — will post progress pings.

Maya (partnerships): @Ben can you DM the rack map? We need exact PDU outlets to script power toggles in the later pass. Also confirm who on your side is the publishing contact. :thumbsup:

Ben (VoltEdge): Sending rack map in DM now. PDU creds will come via SecretsManager invite to `bench-team@redwood`. Publishing contact is me (Ben) + legal (cc).

Nora (docs): I'll draft the joint announcement outline after the delta table lands. Target publish window: ~2 weeks after data is signed off, assuming approvals.

Maya (partnerships): Great — sync notes and the run checklist will be posted here after the kickoff. Thanks everyone.
